what_the_commitment_is_for: tamper-evidence. The determinations are fixed at this hash; a later reader verifies the rows still hash to it.
WHY_THIS_EXISTS: DA 215: per-day results are VISIBLE by USER instruction. That makes the quality rule the one thing still holding -- a seat that has seen days 1-3's values must not be the thing that decides whether day 4 is admissible. This determination was made BEFORE ANY FORWARD DAY WAS VALUED, and by an INSTRUMENT whose inputs are structurally restricted, so the seat does not get to decide and cannot.
THE_FOUR_ARE_FINAL: 09-07, 09-08, 09-09 and 09-10 are determined ADMITTED at a moment when NO forward value exists anywhere. That guarantee was available only now and it has been taken.

THE_TWO_THAT_COULD_NOT_BE.why: the UTC days had not closed; their metadata does not exist yet
THE_TWO_THAT_COULD_NOT_BE.when: the moment each closes -- 09-12T00:00Z and 09-13T00:00Z -- and BEFORE any valuation touches that day
THE_TWO_THAT_COULD_NOT_BE.AND_THE_RESIDUAL_I_WILL_NOT_MANUFACTURE_: by then, earlier days WILL have been valued and seen. So for these two the determination is NOT made in ignorance of results, and no ordering fixes that -- the days do not exist yet. WHAT REPLACES THE GUARANTEE IS THE INSTRUMENT: the same function, the same bars, the same allowlist, and a guard that REFUSES any path that could carry an outcome. The judgement is not a seat's to make, so having seen results cannot enter it.
THE_TWO_THAT_COULD_NOT_BE.what_would_break_it: a human overriding the instrument's verdict for either day. That would be a selection, and it is the one act this design cannot prevent -- only make visible.

BARS_WERE_READ_NOT_TYPED: P1_LOST_S_PER_HR_MAX, P2_MATERIAL_SPAN_S and P2_MATERIAL_SHARE_MAX are IMPORTED from da_forward_day_verify, where they were declared long before today. Inventing a bar now -- having seen the gap counts -- would be choosing a threshold on seen metadata, which is the same act one level up.
